message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that cover a range of sub‑genres—from supernatural chills to psychological dread and outright gore. Pick whatever mood you’re in!

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre / Notable Elements |
|---|-------|------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological thriller; iconic shower scene. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Haunted hotel, isolation, supernatural terror. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Slasher, Michael Myers, jump scares. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Demonic possession, intense atmosphere. |
| 5 | **A Nightmare on Elm Street** | 1984 | Dream‑world horror, Freddy Krueger. |
| 6 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Viral cursed videotape, eerie pacing. |
| 7 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Family trauma, supernatural dread, unsettling imagery. |
| 8 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social commentary, psychological horror. |
| 9 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Slow‑moving entity, creepy soundtrack. |
| 10 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror, cult rituals. |
| 11 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror, mother‑child dynamic. |
| 12 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal investigators, real‑life inspiration. |
| 13 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage style, subtle dread. |
| 14 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑horror, twist on tropes. |
| 15 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | Dance academy, supernatural, striking visuals. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a specific sub‑genre, era, or even a particular type of scare (e.g., jump‑scares vs. atmospheric dread). Happy watching!
